units.english: John Carmack was born on August 20, 1970. From Commander Keen to Doom and Quake, his work reveals a consistent line of thought: identify the constraint blocking an experience, find a sufficiently efficient solution and then build the game around what that solution makes possible. Carmack's influence therefore concerns graphics, but also the way the industry thinks about tools, performance and technical sharing.
